thread:
nora: Heads-up: coordinated rollout planned Thu 22:00-01:00 UTC. Cross-service order proposal: router prewarm -> api canary -> runtime canary -> console. Need explicit handshake, rollback lattice, and quick-run commands for oncall.

ben: ordering ok. router prewarm first so route tables and header-split are validated before runtime handles new traffic. Keep kernel flags frozen.

serena: pin/fallback plan: api v2.30 (fallback v2.29), runtime v7.0 (fallback v6.9), router header-split v1.14 (rollback v1.13). console telemetry behind flag; no schema writes.

huang: canaries: router 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%; api 1% -> 15% -> full; runtime 1% -> 20% -> 60% -> full. console hold at 10% until router 25%+ ok.

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT: running checks: config-lock, schema-compat, dep-graph, infra-headroom.

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT RESULTS: config-lock OK, schema-compat INFO (console optional field added but guarded), dep-graph OK, infra-headroom OK.

serena: console guard implemented to ignore optional telemetry field. Add feature-flagging in rollout.

ben: router-change risk: cache-churn observed in prior header-swap; recommend bump router cache TTLs to 45m during ramp and conservative eviction policy on runtime for 1h post-deploy.

nora: added TTL bump and runtime eviction safety to the playbook. Also adding traffic-shift knobs: gradual weight move with 5m soak between major increments.

huang: monitoring thresholds for auto-actions? Need clear numbers to put in runbook.

pagerbot: ALERT RULES (window):
- request_error_rate > 1.8% sustained 3m -> page #platform-oncall
- p95 latency increase > 45% over baseline for 4m -> notify #infra
- runtime OOM events >=2 across any AZ within 10m -> auto-rollback runtime
- router header-swap failure rate >0.7% for 5m -> rollback router

serena: manual abort: any CS-reported customer-impacting outage -> immediate pause + pin back to last-known-stable across services.

ben: adding rollback/runbook snippets:
```
# router rollback to 1.13
deploybot rollback --service router --to-version 1.13 --reason "header-swap regressions"
# runtime rollback to 6.9
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version 6.9 --reason "health triggers"
# api pin back to 2.29
deploybot pin --service api --version 2.29 --note "emergency pin"
```

huang: will rehearse these in staging and validate alerts.

deploybot: SCHEDULE: dry-run canary 21:50 UTC; Wave 1 (router prewarm) 22:00 UTC; Wave 2 (api canary) 22:20 UTC; Wave 3 (runtime canary) 23:10 UTC; Wave 4 (console) 00:30 UTC. Maintain 10-20m soak between steps, extend if any warning.

nora: good. I'm assigning watchers: ben -> router/cache, serena -> console schema/flag, huang -> runtime metrics, I'll watch api errors and overall traffic.

pagerbot: REMINDER: quiet-window reserved 22:00-01:00 UTC. Non-critical merges blocked.

serena: ack and will watch console telemetry logs.

ben: ack. monitoring cache-hit and kv-miss, will be ready to bump TTLs further if needed.

huang: ack. watching runtime evictions, CPU, and OOMs.

nora: thanks team. Posting runbook link and handing off to oncall. Ending thread. :shipit:
